subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this task become a maintainer-owned browser/search hardening program, be split into the narrower browser-backed access and external-CDP trackers, or be narrowed to reproducible search-provider bugs only?
rationale: The requested work crosses browser execution, arbitrary web content, CDP/noVNC exposure, search-provider selection, and benchmark methodology, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Split into approved tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require maintainers to split Lightpanda/browser backend design, search-provider bugs, and the benchmark matrix before implementation.

options.title: Move browser backend work to related trackers
options.body: Route Lightpanda and external-CDP work to the existing browser-backed access and external endpoint issues, then leave this issue only for the benchmark matrix.

options.title: Narrow to search bugs only
options.body: Ask reporters to provide concrete SearXNG/PinchTab failing commands and close or defer the broader browser evaluation scope.

recommendation.title: Split into approved tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require maintainers to split Lightpanda/browser backend design, search-provider bugs, and the benchmark matrix before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent browser/security/search path history and product-boundary decisions point most strongly to steipete for deciding how to split or sponsor the work.
